items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Uncle Dick, yeah. There's nothing more I can say about him. Just a good bass player

ctx.x: Right. Now, he was the kind of bass player that could play both tuba and the string bass?

Yeah, he played everything. He was very good. Uncle Dick, yeah. There's nothing more I can say about him. Just a good bass player, and some of them get breaks... He worked with quite a few bands. I can't remember whose bands he worked with...
